recent_en: iCents Group recently secured three sub-contracts worth approximately RM85.69 million for data centre and semiconductor facility projects. The company held its 2nd AGM on 27 November 2026, with all resolutions passed. Latest quarter (ended 30 September 2026) net profit rose 68.8% year-on-year to RM2.034 million on a 28.9% gross margin.
notable_en: Subsidiaries secured three sub-contracts totalling approximately RM85.69 million for data centre and semiconductor facility projects.
Held its 2nd AGM on 27 November 2026; all resolutions were passed by shareholders.
Latest quarter net profit rose 68.8% year-on-year to RM2.034 million.
risks_en: Managing Director IR Ts. Ong Mum Fei disposed of 15,000,000 ordinary shares (3.000%) on 10 September 2026.
Executive Director Mr Foo Siang Leng disposed of 15,000,000 ordinary shares (3.000%) on 10 September 2026.
Net loss of RM1.246 million for the financial year ended 30 June 2026, with a net margin of -3.5%.
earnings_en: For the financial year ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM35.567 million with a net loss of RM1.246 million and a net margin of -3.5%; revenue rose 7.1% QoQ while net income fell 134.6% QoQ; revenue grew 89.4% YoY while net income fell 227.3% YoY.
